label.zh: 数年后，追问克隆人的来历
label.en: Years later, question the clones' origins

opening.evidence: common/inline_scripts/game_start/origin_clone_army.txt schedules carrier_event clones.10 after 1095 days plus random 720; its response creates clone_army_digsite

uncertain: The site failure outcomes (ancrel.80xx) are the shared dig-site random events.

label.zh: 挖掘之后对待历史的态度

note.zh: 13的选项a：数年后的“出土记录”（14，不光彩的领导，可再公开道歉15）；选项b：30–90天后“光荣的领导”（16）。
note.en: Option a of 13: Unearthed Records (14, dishonourable leadership, a public apology 15 may follow); option b: Honorable Leadership (16) after 30-90 days (events/clone_army_events.txt:309-405).

note.zh: 21同时开放两个项目（潜能项目仅玩家可见）；完成后分别触发22（新日出）与23（极限潜能）。
note.en: Event 21 enables both projects (potential only for players); completion fires 22 (A New Day Dawns) and 23 (Fullest Potential) (events/clone_army_events.txt:450-483, :484-662).

label.zh: 新日降临：克隆生育恢复
label.en: A New Day Dawns: clone fertility restored

note.zh: 拆除古老克隆舱，改为自然繁衍。
note.en: The ancient vats are dismantled; the clones reproduce.

notes.zh: 开局设置（1095±720天后）触发；回应创建遗址“母星发掘”。隐藏事件 clones.1/2/3/5/24/30 负责克隆人口的增长、衰减与星球丢失清理，不属于叙事窗口。
notes.en: Scheduled by the start setup 1095+0-720 days after start (common/inline_scripts/game_start/origin_clone_army.txt); its response creates the Homeworld Excavation site. Hidden clones.1/2/3/5/24/30 handle clone population growth, decline and cleanup (no windows).

notes.zh: 遗址阶段2同时安排两条线：30–60天后 clones.13（历史的选择）与 360–720天后 clones.4（克隆生育项目）。
notes.en: Site stage 2 schedules two lines: clones.13 after 30-60 days and clones.4 after 360-720 days (events/clone_army_events.txt:302-303).
